description:
Initialization: Assign tasks (ascending eligible satellite count, then ID) to satellite minimizing 
(assigned duration + task duration) / max(window capacity, 1e-12); tie-break by smaller ID. 
Unassigned if no candidates. (Window capacity: sum of durations of windows with candidates).

Reassignment (unobserved tasks by ascending alternative count, descending reward, then task ID):
- Migration: Test non-owner satellites with candidates, ordered by observed duration / max(window capacity, 1e-12), then smaller ID.
- Swap: After migrations exhaust, test task pairs on different satellites (descending reward, ascending task ID) with mutual candidates.
- Acceptance: Require feasibility and strictly higher profit; restart from Migration.
- Termination: Move exhaustion or timeout.
